verdict.rationale: The only webhook evidence is Bridge, part of Stripe's crypto stack. Its docs say webhooks deliver real-time notifications of events in your Bridge account, which covers on-ramp, off-ramp and crypto-to-crypto flows. Nothing confirms signed payloads or the specific events the story names, and the Stripe stablecoin payments, payouts and Treasury docs in the pack never mention webhooks. Missing for 10: evidence that webhooks are signed, documented event types for payment confirmed, payout settled and conversion executed, webhook coverage for Stripe-native stablecoin payments and payouts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
